name: Bash Terminal
description: Executes shell and terminal commands inside the execution workspace.
short_description: Execute shell and terminal commands inside the isolated execution workspace.
store_description: Built-in shell executor that runs bash/terminal commands inside the execution workspace. The working directory is pinned to the workspace root and cannot escape it. Intended for file inspection, build steps, and running project scripts. On Windows hosts the shell may not support POSIX constructs such as 'mkdir -p', '&&', or 'touch' — prefer the workspace file editor (str_replace_editor) for file operations, and prefer source_control for Git operations.

ar.short_description: Execute shell and terminal commands inside the isolated execution workspace.

working_directory.description: Either 'workspace_root' or a relative path inside the workspace. Cannot escape the workspace.

allowed_commands.description: Optional allow-list of executable names. When empty, the built-in policy is used.

usage_notes: Commands run inside the workspace root; the shell cannot escape it. On Windows hosts, POSIX constructs such as 'mkdir -p', '&&', and 'touch' may not be available — use the workspace file editor (str_replace_editor) for file operations, and source_control for Git operations. Always quote paths. Long-running processes are bounded by the configured timeout.

command.description: Shell command to execute inside the workspace.
